intro: Isi pax dan tarikh berlepas / balik — panjang trip, peak season dan semua surcharge dikira sendiri dan terus masuk dalam harga per pax. Harga asas = harga katalog (Basic RM1,297 · Standard RM1,497 · Honeymoon RM2,897/pasangan); diskaun Tier 2 (−RM200/pax) TIDAK dikira di sini — tolak sendiri kalau quote guna Tier 2. Malam tambahan / tolak: kadar rate card diberi per bilik dan ditukar ke per pax atas asas 2 pax sebilik. Hari tambahan: Krabi tiada kadar transport hari tambahan yang tersiar — kalkulator akan tandakan kadar belum diisi (merah) supaya TC sebut harga dengan operator, bukan quote RM 0.

paxNotes.text: Katalog Krabi 2026 beri harga rata untuk 2–10 pax.
11 pax ke atas: katalog hanya sampai 10 pax dan rate card tiada tier lanjutan. Sebut harga baharu dengan operator — jangan guna tier 2–10.

validity: Prices are based on the PT Krabi 2026 catalogues last updated 7 August 2026 and are valid for travel until 31 December 2026; departures from 1 January 2027 must be requoted. This quotation is valid for 24 hours. A deposit of RM250 per person is due on confirmation and full payment 45 days before departure. A late booking surcharge of RM50 per booking applies to bookings made less than 45 days before departure. Prices are for 2 to 3 persons per room. Private transportation and tour guide are on a 10 hours basis; extra hours are payable in cash to the driver. The final itinerary and hotel arrangements are confirmed at least 15 days before the trip. Island activities are subject to weather conditions.
